champions.gameplayImpact: Mel loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Mel's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Overwhelm to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking infinitely.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Overwhelm: Store 20px (+ 25% AP) magic damage on the affected enemy with the first stack, reducedagainst minions. For each stack, store an additional 20px (+ 0.75% AP) magic damage on the target. If the total stored would deal death to the target (including through shields), the next stack will consume them all to deal the damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate - Searing Brilliance: Mel's ability casts each generate 3 stacks of Searing Brilliance for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of Searing Brilliance to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals 5–20|magic damage (+ 1% AP) magic damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Mel launches a barrage of 6–10 luminous bolts at the target location over which distribute evenly in the area. Each bolt explodes upon landing to deal 13 (16 ranks) (+ 8.5% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies, reduced to 75% against minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The bolts momentarily grant sight during their travel, while the explosions grant sight over their target area. Both can see through brush and terrain.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: 0.25 seconds, Speed: , Effect Radius: / , cr 60.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Mel forms a protective barrier around herself for 1 second, becoming invulnerable to non-turret damage and gaining 30% decaying bonus movement speed. All hostile non-turret projectiles that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before Mel fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the original sources, or toward herself.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Replicated projectiles have the that the original ones do, but they retain 40–70% (+ 5% per 100 AP) of the damage that the original ones would deal, and all of their damage is converted to magic|magic damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Mel fires an orb in the target direction that grants sight of its for 0.25 seconds as it travels. Enemies hit by the orb are dealt 60–220 (+ 50% AP) magic damage and root for a 1.75–2.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The orb emanates a field of solar radiation that additionally expands after a 0.5-second delay. Enemies within the field are dealt 2–10 (+ 1% AP) magic damage and slow by 30% every 0.125 seconds, lingering for 0.75 seconds after exiting.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Both the orb and the field of Solar Snare deal 50% damage against minions.
